title: Domain Warp
description: Warp fBm with fBm, and let it drift. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 (aspect-corrected, centred). Let p = uv * 1.2. Use value noise on an integer lattice with the PCG hash, no sin: pcg(v) sets state = v * 747796405u + 2891336453u and word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u, and returns (word >> 22u) ^ word. A lattice corner c gets float(pcg(pcg(uint(c.x)) + uint(c.y)) >> 8) / 16777216.0, and the four corners blend by the smoothstep curve f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f). fbm has 4 octaves: start at amplitude 0.5, double the frequency and halve the amplitude each octave, then divide the sum by 0.9375. Let fbm2(x) = vec2(fbm(x), fbm(x + vec2(5.2, 1.3))). The drift is 0.3 * vec2(cos(a), sin(a)) with a = 6.28318 * u_time / 16.0, one loop every 16 seconds. Then q = fbm2(p + drift), r = fbm2(p + 2.0 * q + vec2(1.7, 9.2)) and v = fbm(p + 2.0 * r). For colour, mix ink (0.05, 0.03, 0.18) into magenta (0.75, 0.20, 0.45) by smoothstep(0.40, 0.55, v), then into pale gold (1.00, 0.85, 0.55) by smoothstep(0.58, 0.72, v).
